perspective:
**Christian Mensah’s available information:**

- He is a police officer and has been close friends with Jonathan since childhood; he often seeks Jonathan’s advice and values his perspective.
- Recently, Christian noticed Jonathan acting differently and came to believe Jonathan was hiding something important. This made him anxious and suspicious.
- Christian arranged a meeting with Jonathan at their favorite coffee shop and confronted him about it.
- Christian heard Jonathan say he could trust him, then heard Jonathan admit he had been hiding something because he was in trouble and didn’t know how to tell Christian.
- Christian told Jonathan he was worried and offered help. Jonathan replied that the situation was complicated, that he didn’t want to drag Christian in, but eventually accepted support/resources and said he needed a way out.
- Christian asked if the trouble was illegal. Jonathan said he couldn’t be sure, might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but denied doing anything illegal himself. Christian decided to investigate discreetly.
- Through his investigation, Christian came to believe Jonathan was being framed and that someone was setting him up. He told Jonathan he had leads but not the culprit yet, and planned to gather more evidence.
- Later, Christian’s investigation led him to believe/know that the culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan. He told Jonathan he had found out who was behind it—someone they both know and trust—and decided to confront that person and bring them to justice.
- Jonathan thanked Christian, trusted him to handle things carefully, and warned him that the person may be dangerous.
